title: Hell’s Paradise: Jigokuraku
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In Edo-period Japan, the condemned ninja Gabimaru is offered a pardon if he retrieves the elixir of immortality from the island of Shinsenkyo. Ten death-row convicts, each watched by an executioner of the Yamada Asaemon clan, face monstrous beings and deadly plants there, while Gabimaru fights to return to his wife.
life_message: Holds up love and human bonds as what makes life worth living, set against a search for immortality and a life of killing.
